name: codex-insights
description: Private, trust-aware reports from local Codex sessions. Community $insights skill inspired by Claude Code /insights.

interface.shortDescription: Private, trust-aware reports from your local Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Create a local-only or model-assisted report of your Codex sessions on this machine. Inspired by Claude Code /insights (how you work, not a token bill). Local-only is the default: zero model calls, visible coverage, and credential redaction. Model-assisted narratives run only after an estimate and confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Use $insights to make a private local-only report of my recent Codex sessions.
Use $insights to estimate a model-assisted report.
Use $insights to create a model-assisted report after I confirm the estimate.
